lines: Piper is a dog with a special job.
He works at an airport in Michigan, USA.
He keeps the airport safe from birds and foxes.
Border collies are very good at herding animals.
Piper chases wild animals away from planes and runways.
When Piper works, he wears safety glasses, earmuffs, and a vest.
They help Piper do his job well.
Piper’s owner and trainer, Brian Edwards, works with Piper.
He found Piper’s talent when Piper was seven.
Now, Edwards and the airport staff are very proud of him.
body.text: Meet Piper. Piper is a dog with a special job. He works at an airport in Michigan, USA. He keeps the airport safe from birds and foxes. Piper is a border collie. Border collies are very good at herding animals. Piper chases wild animals away from planes and runways. When Piper works, he wears safety glasses, earmuffs, and a vest. They help Piper do his job well. Piper’s owner and trainer, Brian Edwards, works with Piper. He found Piper’s talent when Piper was seven. Now, Edwards and the airport staff are very proud of him.
